name: Magical Kanan - Magical Fantasy Box
original_name: まじかるカナン MAGICAL FANTASY BOX
source:
Among other goodies game includes a quiz and a story mini-game with timed choices "The exciting time bomb".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
